title: Walt Disney (DIS) Offers Early Retirement Packages To Veteran Executives In Cost Cut Push
summary: Walt Disney (NYSE:DIS) has introduced a Voluntary Early Retirement Offer aimed at veteran executives as part of a cost reduction effort. The program targets longtime leaders across key divisions, with the goal of streamlining the management structure and lowering expenses. The move extends Disney's broader restructuring drive, which is focused on adjusting to ongoing pressures across media, streaming, and parks businesses. title: Summer Blockbusters Are Filling Movie Theaters. The Stocks Are the Stars.
summary: Hollywood just marked its fourth consecutive $1 billion month of domestic box office sales, and movie theater operators are celebrating.  The July 31 opening weekend of Sony Pictures’ Spider-Man: Brand New Day launched  AMC Entertainment  to its highest revenue weekend for tickets and food-and-beverage sales in its 106-year history, counting more than 10.2 million moviegoers in its theaters in the U.S. and worldwide.  According to CEO Adam Aron, Spider-Man was the ninth movie title since March to have a “gangbusters opening-weekend gross.”
